main_subject.description: An adult woman with a bright playful smile and strong lens awareness.
main_subject.wardrobe: A textured faux-fur jacket over a plain charcoal knit, straight dark jeans, and simple black ankle boots.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: She leans slightly toward camera in a relaxed upright stance, hands loosely together in front, with eyes toward the lens.

composition_elements.setting: An urban sidewalk at night, subject in the left third with blurred anonymous city lights and storefront shapes filling the negative space.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No user-portrait requirement, storefront copy, logos, watermark, or visible brand graphic.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Hard direct on-camera flash against a dark cool street background with defined drop shadow.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Spontaneous, friendly, slightly gritty, and energetic.

technical_specs.rendering: Cool background, warm flash skin tones, high contrast, crisp face, realistic hands, and restrained grain.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical Fujifilm Classic Negative-inspired flash street snapshot of an adult woman with a bright playful smile and strong lens awareness. She wears a textured faux-fur jacket over a plain charcoal knit, straight dark jeans, and simple black ankle boots. Place her upright and slightly leaning toward camera in the left third of a nighttime sidewalk; her hands rest loosely together in front and her eyes meet the lens. Fill the right-side negative space with blurred anonymous city lights and storefront shapes. Use hard direct on-camera flash, defined drop shadow, cool background, warm flash skin, high contrast, crisp face, realistic hands, and restrained grain. No portrait-slot dependency, readable storefront copy, logos, watermark, or brand graphics.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, fetish styling, sexualized pose, forced knees-in pose, logo, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Identity references are optional and must depict a consenting adult. Replaceable wardrobe and streetscape references must omit store text, logos, and personal identity information.
